batch: T10-AUTH6 fixed auth adapter, revised for the real resolveAuth material shape
scope: Pure Node: the real runAuthFlow and the real AUTH-5 private port over synthetic FakeBrowser primitives with an explicitly labeled Fake Runtime. No browser, Playwright, worker-entry, provider, deploy, or real Coordinator.
materialInterface: CredentialMaterial.material.storageState, exactly as LeaseRepository.resolveAuth returns it (JSON string) or a plain approved object; validated only by the private port approved-state validator. No alias key, no local parse, no normalization.

auth5Formatting.note: private-auth.ts/test were Prettier-formatted in this batch; semantics unchanged and the AUTH-5 suites still pass 8/8 private-port + 20/20 approved-state (41/41 package).

cases.name: form flow runs the fixed order once through the fake runtime
one OTP at most, and never a second wait after a criterion failure
storage_state prepares without navigating, then navigates once
record, observation, capture and finish failures never yield success
missing or unsupported configuration is blocked, never passed
unknown, raw, or getter-throwing codes fall back to constants
none never touches material, the port, or the adapters
abort cancels the flow without any success or capture
the private ticket and capture material stay out of the outcome
storage_state material takes only the canonical resolveAuth shape
the port must belong to the same session as the binding

interfaceCompatibilityNegatives: legacy/alias material key `state` -> MATERIAL_INVALID with zero primitive calls
storageState number/array/null/empty string/class instance/form-only keys -> MATERIAL_INVALID
malformed JSON string and unknown fields -> VALIDATION_ERROR from the real port validator
foreign cookie domain and foreign origin entry -> TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED
accessor inside the state object -> VALIDATION_ERROR and the getter is never invoked
port.sessionId != binding.sessionId -> SESSION_MISMATCH before any material or primitive call
interfaceNotesForRoot: AuthActionRequest = {requestId, sessionId, action, slot, target?}; the navigate URL always comes from the permit.
AuthFlowRuntime.recordAuth must attach the begin receipt and forward to the auth service method; the ordinary recordAction/HTTP channel is never used.
Permit fields contextId/profileId/profileVersion/authEpoch/purpose are used as returned; the flow never fabricates or downgrades them.
form uses material.username/password; storage_state uses material.storageState (JSON string or plain object).
storage_state takes its frozen criterion from options.criterion; form always uses profile.formConfig.successCriterion.

Known error codes pass through only from an explicit allowlist (contract ERROR_CODES + browser STABLE_REASON_CODES + port CANCELLED); unknown or getter-throwing codes become constant fallbacks and error.message is never read.
notImplemented: no real Coordinator capture CAS, OTP service, or Worker.once wiring; Stage.auth stays unwired in this batch
positive capture evidence comes from a Fake Runtime only, so no service-verified ticket or stateRef is claimed
no distributed exactly-once guarantee; the flow guarantees one attempt per action and at most one OTP wait
no real browser / session.ts integration; Ego verification stays paused
